title: Rubber
description: A song title moulded in soft orange rubber, lying on a warm white table. Press a letter and it squashes: the rubber under your finger gets thinner and, keeping its volume, spreads out sideways and shoulders its neighbours aside. Let go and it rings back into shape with a damped wobble. Drag to pull it and it stretches thin.
intent: From GT Maru (Grilli Type, https://www.itsnicethat.com/articles/grilli-type-gt-maru-graphic-design-200521, https://www.gt-maru.com): soft corners engineered so precisely that a cuddly face still reads as serious type. Here the softness is literal, a soft-body lattice per letter with area and volume preserved, shot like a Teenage Engineering rubber object.
